opening.argument: The presenter leads with unusually high return claims, promising “around 85% APR on Bitcoin” and “350% APR on Ethereum.” He then ties those figures to placing crypto assets into liquidity pairs, explaining that liquidity providers receive fees when users swap tokens. After reporting $5.5 in transaction fees over roughly 12 hours, he projects 16.5% monthly returns and says that a $1,000 contribution would make $160 a month. The pitch therefore connects projected income to capital participation in liquidity pools and farms, rather than presenting an isolated return figure. Although he notes that positions can stop earning when out of range and urges viewers to assess the risks themselves, the supplied material does not independently verify the APRs or establish sustained results; these remain his claims and projections.
